General Practitioner – Windmill Practice (DPA/MMM3)
Tamworth, NSW
Permanent / Locum
Mixed Billing

Are you a GP with General or Specialist Registration looking for a rewarding opportunity to grow professionally and personally while making a real impact in a thriving regional community?

Join the team at Windmill Practice, a modern, purpose-built primary care facility committed to high-quality, holistic healthcare for families and individuals across Tamworth and surrounding areas. You’ll be supported by an experienced clinical team and an efficient administrative group, allowing you to focus on what you do best — delivering excellent patient care.

About the Practice:

Located at 34 Verdelho Drive, Tamworth, NSW in a convenient regional setting.

Modern consulting and treatment rooms with supportive nursing and admin staff.

Mixed billing model with bulk-billing available for eligible patient groups (children, DVA card holders, etc).

Electronic health records and online appointment systems.

Onsite and local pathology, imaging, allied health services within minutes.

Flexible working arrangements and patient base ready for growth.

Location:
Tamworth is a vibrant regional centre in northern NSW known for its strong community feel, family-friendly lifestyle, great schools, and local amenities — while still providing easy access to larger city services.

Position Description:

You will be responsible for delivering safe, high-quality medical care in a community-focused general practice setting. Key duties include:
Providing comprehensive clinical care and patient-centred consultations.
Demonstrating compliance with relevant legislation, guidelines, and practice standards.
Maintaining accurate medical records and clinical documentation.
Communicating effectively across all patient demographics.
Working collaboratively within the practice team and independently when required.
Upholding confidentiality and professional integrity at all times.
Commitment to ongoing professional development.
Skills & Attributes:
Sound clinical judgement with excellent interpersonal communication.
Ability to build trusting relationships with patients and colleagues.
A proactive, empathetic approach to patient care.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

Get in Touch:
If you’d like to know more about this role or clinic, please click “Apply Now” or contact Silvana (silvana@doctorsandco.com.au
) from our recruitment team for a confidential discussion.
